name: NewsBrief
description: A news report retold as a brief card, for a scene about what a report found (use it instead of a screenshot of a news page): a dark pill kicker with the source and date (the card adds the lead-in in the project's language: "Source: " in English, a Chinese or Japanese one in those locales; the date drops under the pill when both do not fit), the headline big in the display face (up to 132 px for a short one) with a gold marker sweeping under hot words, a rule drawing across, then up to three points landing one by one with small markers (a hot point gets an accent dot and a marker band). The card fills its box and grows down to each point as it lands, centred on its final height: give it about 760-840 wide x 600-1000 tall (it works from 600 x 500 up to wide boxes); three long points want h >= 760.

source.description: who reported it, e.g. Reuters; the card adds the lead-in (a leading "Source:" here is dropped)

headline.description: your own one-line retelling of the report, not the outlet's title; best under 50 Latin or 26 CJK characters

points.description: 0-3 key facts that land one by one under the rule

text.description: one fact: at most 50 Latin or 22 CJK characters

at.description: Time it lands: "line:4" or seconds from the clip start. Default: 1 s after the card, then every 0.8 s

hot.description: the one point that matters: accent dot and a marker band
exact substrings of headline to sweep with the gold marker after it lands

at.description: Time the card lands: "line:2" or seconds from the clip start. Nothing shows before it. Default: the clip start

color.description: colour of the hot point's dot: theme token or CSS

ground.description: light = cream card with ink text; dark = night card with snow text

example.headline: Free noodles next door cut three shops' sales in half

points.text: A month in, a queue of 100+ every day
Next door: from 300 bowls a day to 100
The owner pays for it with livestream sales
